transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. It's very nice to meet you too. Um, I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time today. 

I just... well, I feel a little embarrassed even saying it out loud, because I know how it might sound. But I came in because, even on my better days lately, I just can't seem to shake this feeling. It's probably just my imagination, but... I feel like some of the people at my church, and in my walking club, are watching me. And, um, sometimes I think they're putting little messages about me in the Sunday bulletin, or hiding things in what they say when we talk. 

I know that sounds a bit silly, doesn't it? I just wanted to see if maybe that's something you could help me with, if that's alright?
How long have you been feeling that these people are sending you these messages?

Oh, goodness, let me think... I really hope I'm not making a mountain out of a molehill, but... I suppose it's been going on for a little while now. Maybe about eleven months? 

And, um... I probably should mention this too, just so I'm giving you all the right information... along with the messages, I've also been hearing some voices now and then. And I just seem to have a little trouble keeping my thoughts straight sometimes. 

I hope I'm explaining that okay? I just want to make sure I'm answering your questions right, doctor.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was extremely low or unusually high and energetic, lasting for several days or weeks at a time?

Well, um... I definitely wouldn't say I've been unusually high or energetic. I'm usually pretty quiet. But... I suppose I have been feeling a bit down. 

I don't want to sound like I'm complaining, because I know everyone gets sad sometimes, and I have so much to be thankful for. But... it's been this really deep sadness, and I just feel so guilty about things, even when I know I shouldn't. And I just don't have much interest in doing the things I usually enjoy, like my walking club or even going to church. 

It's been going on for a little while now... maybe a year and two months? I try to push through it and put on a brave face, but it just seems to linger. Is that the kind of thing you were asking about, Dr. Smith? I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is.
Looking back, did you start feeling this deep sadness before or after you first began noticing those messages and hearing the voices?

Oh, dear... let me think about that. I want to make sure I get the timeline right for you. 

Um... well, I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. The sadness has been there for quite a while, like I said, and the... the messages and things, they kind of crept up on me. I really couldn't say for certain which one started first. They just sort of... blended together at some point, I suppose. 

I'm so sorry, I know that's not a very helpful answer. I just don't want to tell you the wrong thing. Is it okay that I can't quite remember exactly when one started compared to the other?

Looking back over the entire time you've felt unwell, would you say that you have been experiencing that deep, persistent sadness during most of the time that you've also been hearing voices and feeling like people are watching you?

Well... yes, I think so. I really hope I'm not overstating things, but... yes. For most of this whole time, that heavy sadness and the guilt, and just not caring about my usual activities... they've been right there in the background. 

Even on the days when the voices aren't so loud, or when I'm not quite as worried about the messages... the sadness is still there. It just seems to sit with me, if that makes sense? 

I feel terrible complaining about it, I really do. I know I should be stronger. But... does that answer your question, doctor? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things have been.

During the entire time you have been feeling unwell, have there been any periods of at least two weeks where you were hearing those voices or feeling watched, but were NOT feeling that deep sadness or loss of interest?

Well... let me think. I don't want to give you the wrong idea, but... yes, I suppose there was a time like that. 

Um... there was a spell, maybe for a few weeks, where I actually felt a little bit lighter. I was getting dressed every day, and eating a little bit better, and I just didn't feel quite so... weighed down by everything. I even thought maybe I was turning a corner, which was nice. 

But... well, even during those better weeks, I... I still heard my name being called when I was alone in the house. And... I still had this feeling that the people at church were sort of hinting about me when they talked. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound completely silly. I really was trying my best to do better during that time. Is that the sort of thing you needed to know, doctor? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it right.
